title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 11.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: .NET 11.0 for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 includes a security update addressing an ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-114148. This update also contains bug fixes and enhancements as part of the release candidate 3 update. The vulnerability affects multiple .NET versions including 8.0, 9.0, 10.0, and 11.0. Red Hat has rated this security issue as Important and provides updated packages to remediate the flaw.
